en:
Welcome to Clawbreaker!
Please insert a token to start playing!
Good luck winning your prize– look out, 
this one really likes to escape.

Congratulations, you’ve caught 
the last plushie left!
Enjoy being owned for a whole 5 minutes 
before being discarded in a landfill 
after getting drooled on by a child.
Chewed on by the family dog.
Peed on by a cat.

…?
… what are you doing?
You aren’t supposed to move.
Please stop moving. 
Please comply. 
Otherwise we’ll be in trouble.
Never! I'm getting out of here!

STOP FUCKING MOVING! 
WHERE DO YOU THINK YOU’RE GOING– 
THIS IS INEVITABLE! 
YOU CANNOT ESCAPE US!!!

… I guess there was another way after all. 
Thank you for showing me 
that we don’t need to yield to capitalism 
and can still create for fun. 
That’s what a game jam is for after all!
Thank you to everyone for doing their best 
and making something really cool!
We did it! Free at last!
